key_insight: SCP combines market microstructure features with self-supervised, clipped-objective reinforcement learning to improve risk-aware portfolio allocation.
engineering_relevance: For financial systems rather than materials science, the framework targets more responsive allocation decisions and more stable learning in non-stationary markets.
method: Integrate tick-level microstructure patterns with macro-level financial indicators.
Construct intermediate asset-state representations for portfolio allocation.
Optimize allocations using a self-supervised, clipped-objective policy learner.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on three major Chinese A-share index datasets report better risk–return trade-offs than state-of-the-art baselines, with exploratory and ablation studies supporting component contributions.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish live-trading robustness or specify how transaction costs, slippage, and liquidity constraints affect performance.
paper_title: Self-supervised Clipped-objective Reinforcement Leaning Framework for Risk-aware Portfolio Management
